Device Battery Status is a Windows 10/11 x64 tray monitor for USB 2.4 GHz peripherals. This is an **unsigned prerelease**.

### Downloads

- **Self-contained ZIP:** includes .NET/Windows Desktop Runtime 10.0.13; no separate .NET installation is needed.
- **Framework-dependent ZIP:** smaller; requires Microsoft .NET 10 Windows Desktop Runtime x64. The base .NET Runtime alone is insufficient for WPF.

Download an application ZIP directly from this release, extract the entire ZIP and keep all files together. Release assets have no extra workflow-artifact wrapper. The embedded guide also describes downloading CI artifacts; that wrapper instruction applies only to downloads from Actions. Read the included guide and notices before use. The verification ZIP contains the full test reports, logs and source/package provenance.

### Included

- Battery monitoring, tray/popup display, freshness and stale-data handling, settings and percentage-based alerts.
- Logitech native battery categories without estimated percentages or percentage bars. Advertised HID++ percentage alternatives are preferred when available; failed optional queries retain a successfully reported category and its original time.
- Deliberate manual Razer HyperSpeed/HyperPolling and Logitech polling-rate controls. High-rate Razer profiles include the documented two-command sequence and explicit same-rate recovery attempts.
- A source-backed Alienware Pro headset reader for receiver `413C:A529`, derived independently from documented AWCC capture evidence.

### Verification

Application source and tag target: `b53b6b777d409f83d081b51a7a3be4f06c1aa45d`.

- [Windows compilation and package inspection](https://github.com/kA-sp3R/BatteryStatusCheck/actions/runs/39527777290): passed; both ZIPs passed static PE, runtime metadata, license provenance and payload-hash inspection.
- [Full automated software suite](https://github.com/kA-sp3R/BatteryStatusCheck/actions/runs/39528608946): the entire solution was tested without filters on Windows in Debug and Release. All 451 C# tests passed in Debug and again in Release (902 C# test executions), and all five offline parser tests passed. No failures or skips. Results are recorded in the attached verification bundle.
- No application launch or physical hardware test is part of those automated checks. Runtime behavior, visual placement, notifications, Windows startup, firmware compatibility, reconnect behavior, battery accuracy and actual USB reporting frequency remain unverified.

### Accuracy and limitations

- Genuine reported `0%` remains valid. Logitech HID++ `1000` defines level zero as unknown; that sentinel is not a measured zero. Categories and voltages are never converted into invented percentages.
- Current, stale, disconnected, unsupported and failed readings remain distinct. Receiver presence alone does not establish a connected peripheral; charging and radio-link state are independent.
- Selected receiver IDs and feature sets are implemented; model-family names do not establish compatibility. Bluetooth and wired device IDs are excluded. Razer generic HyperPolling paired-mouse identity and battery remain unsupported; its manual control addresses receiver configuration. Alienware hardware compatibility is unverified.
- Polling-rate controls start disabled and require an explicit Apply. Interrupted sequences may already have changed configuration and are not retried automatically. Readback verifies reported configuration, not measured physical reporting frequency.
